name: gasi-one
description: gasi:one CLI generator from JSON resources for Spring Boot API and React web apps.

scripts.plan:example: node ./bin/gasi-one.js resource plan -f examples/resources.json -o generated --target api
scripts.plan:example:api: node ./bin/gasi-one.js resource plan -f examples/resources.json -o generated --target api
scripts.plan:example:web: node ./bin/gasi-one.js resource plan -f examples/resources.json -o generated --target web
scripts.smoke: node ./bin/gasi-one.js resource sync -f examples/resources.json -o generated --target api
scripts.smoke:api: node ./bin/gasi-one.js resource sync -f examples/resources.json -o generated --target api
scripts.smoke:web: node ./bin/gasi-one.js resource sync -f examples/resources.json -o generated --target web
